title: a newcomer filters Explore with a filter icon, kind pills and a bottom sheet

criteria.text: Kind pills (All, Events, ... Asks) fixed above the bottom nav, All default
criteria.note: Retired: 2026-09-12 'Zero filter pills outside the filter view' (F092 Rulings, design-language principle 10), 2026-09-17 'the shipped kind pill row does not survive' (F059 Rulings) and Don's 2026-10-18 [always] no chip or pill UI anywhere (#951). Built in T114, deleted in #174; `tests/no-chips.test.ts` (#956) fails CI on any `*Pill` component [V].

criteria.text: No separate market/category/day buttons; filter icon at the right of the sticky search bar
criteria.note: Overtaken by Don's 2026-11-01 asks, built in #1161 (2026-11-02): `ExploreSearchBar` and its filter icon are deleted; the filters open from 'More filters' inside the header search's full-screen panel (`HeaderSearch.tsx`) [V]. Shown, not counted.

criteria.text: The filter icon opens a sheet: schedule (any / this week / this weekend), category multi-select, Show results, Clear all when any filter is set
criteria.note: `ExploreFilterSheet.tsx` groups Type, Category, Date (any / today / this weekend / this week, `DATE_OPTIONS` in `lib/browse/filters.ts`) and How far, holds edits as a draft until Show results, and shows Clear all once something is set; it opens from More filters in the header search (#1161) [V]. Checked yes: `ExploreFilterSheet.test.tsx:322` asserts the Date choice, multi-select Category, Show results last and Clear all only once something is set, with 'holds edits as a draft' (111) and 'hides Clear all until something is set' (155) [V]; #1060 claimed it whole and its marker left with the retired scenario (#1069) [A]. Reviewed no (#174, #1060) [A]. Shipped unknown: no deploy-health run read for #174 [A]. Smoked: smoke-live run 45885931303 (2026-11-26, main 71107bcd) opened explore as signed-out, stranger, member and operator, HTTP 200 and passed; the run is red on page and page-business and two sign-ins, not on explore [V gh run log]; it loads the route, it does not open the sheet.

criteria.text: The sheet offers a distance choice (1 / 5 / 10 / 25 mi)
criteria.note: Retired: 2026-09-03 'Distance is out' (`product/ui/surfaces.md`): no radius filter, no mile count, no distance sort; #174 deleted it [V]. Don's 2026-10-18 ruling on #796 (built in #932) adds a 'How far' group in minutes of drive (15 / 30 / 45 / 60 / Whole area), a reach ring, not a mile radius; `ExploreFilterSheet.test.tsx` still asserts 'offers no distance control' [V].

criteria.text: The sheet offers a sort order
criteria.note: Not built: #174 removed Sort ('ordering is the server's'); `ExploreFilterSheet.test.tsx:81` asserts 'offers no sort control' [V]. No ruling retires a member-chosen sort outright: 2026-09-03 rules out distance sort only; F059 criterion 3 fixes the order and the 2026-10-31 ruling lets Find sort by interests, without saying a member may re-sort [V scenario]. Routed to `scope-scenario`; on a retired scenario the simplest ruling is to retire it with the sheet's 'ordering is the server's'.

Retired: the 2026-11-25 ruling in F059's Rulings ('Explore's filter sheet has no Recurring choice; "what's on every week" is a question a member asks', the PM: 'A, drop it'); #827 closed 2026-11-26 [V]. `ExploreFilterSheet.test.tsx:88` already asserts 'offers no Recurring schedule' [V]. Shown, not counted.

criteria.text: Tapping the Events pill filters instantly to gatherings; pill selected state
criteria.note: Retired: 2026-09-12 'Zero filter pills', 2026-09-17 (F059) 'the shipped pill row does not survive', 2026-10-18 no chips anywhere; F092 criterion 1. Events is now a post kind inside the sheet's Type group (#881), committed by Show results [V].

criteria.text: Active secondary filters show as removable chips below the search bar; no chip for kind
criteria.note: Retired: 2026-09-12 'no pill row, chip row or control strip alongside results' (F092 Rulings, principle 10); 2026-09-19 narrowing happens in a modal that writes into the search box; 2026-10-18 no chip UI anywhere. `ActiveFilterChips` was deleted in #174 and `tests/no-chips.test.ts` keeps chips out [V].

criteria.text: Chip row disappears when no chips remain
criteria.note: Retired with criterion 5: there is no chip row (2026-09-12, 2026-09-19 and 2026-10-18 rulings, F092 criterion 1).

criteria.text: The URL carries kind, distance and sort filters
criteria.note: Retired: kind pills (2026-09-12, 2026-09-17) and distance and distance sort (2026-09-03) no longer exist, so nothing remains to put in the URL; `?sort=` and `?distance=` degrade to defaults on purpose (`parseBrowseFilters`) [V]. The Type group's words travel in `?q=` under 7b.

criteria.text: The URL carries the active schedule and tag filters; opening it restores them
criteria.note: The box text is the state: `browseQueryString` writes `q` (Type, Category, Date words and the free search), `metro`, `area` and `reach`; `BrowseSurface` seeds the box from `?q=` and writes the URL with `history.replaceState` (#942) [V query.ts, BrowseSurface.test.tsx]. Checked no: unmarked `query.test.ts:21` ('round-trips through parseBrowseFilters'), `BrowseSurface.test.tsx:497` ('the URL carries the words') and `:551` ('typing writes the words into the URL in place'); nothing asserts a cold `?q=` load lands on the same results (#652) [V]. Reviewed no: #174 no `Reviewed by:`, #750 review-skipped [A]. Shipped yes [A]. Smoked: smoke-live run 45885931303 (2026-11-26, main 71107bcd) opened explore as signed-out, stranger, member and operator, HTTP 200 and passed; the run is red on page and page-business and two sign-ins, not on explore [V gh run log]; it loads the route, it does not open the sheet.

criteria.text: Back from a detail page restores filters and scroll position
criteria.note: Retired: F059 criterion 10 (a shared link reopens the same metro and search; back-navigation restores scroll) is the newer, wider statement; the filters now live in `?q=`. Built in part (`useScrollRestoration('explore', ...)`; #885 keeps how deep the visitor scrolled); the remaining defects (one literal key, restores once per mount) are open #54 under F059 [V].

criteria.text: A dot on the filter icon when secondary filters are active
criteria.note: The dot is `filter-active-dot` on the header search (`HeaderSearch.tsx:104`), driven by `filtersActive` [V]. Checked no: `HeaderSearch.test.tsx` passes `filtersActive: true` (line 155) but never asserts the dot [V grep] (#652). Reviewed no [A]. Shipped unknown [A]. Smoked: smoke-live run 45885931303 (2026-11-26, main 71107bcd) opened explore as signed-out, stranger, member and operator, HTTP 200 and passed; the run is red on page and page-business and two sign-ins, not on explore [V gh run log]; it loads the route, it does not open the sheet.
